description: Create a troubleshooting log spreadsheet from messy notes. Open the text file at /home/ga/Documents/theater_notes.txt containing unstructured home theater problem notes. Create a new spreadsheet with columns: Date, Equipment/Source, Symptom, Action Taken, Result. Extract and enter at least 8 troubleshooting incidents from the notes. Add a COUNTIF formula to count 'Audio Cutout' occurrences. Apply conditional formatting to highlight failed/recurring issues. Sort chronologically. Save as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/theater_troubleshooting.xlsx
